title: La Vie en Rose
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: When 19-year-old Yayoi's parents die, he expects an inheritance but instead inherits a 100 million yen debt owed to the yakuza; his girlfriend dumps him and points him to host work. A wealthy businessman, Kazu(to), offers to take on the debt if Yayoi will become his, and Yayoi wonders what the price will be (AniList, MU, ANN; English title A Rose-Colored Life from Digital Manga).
life_message: A relationship that begins as a debt arrangement is shown turning into love.
